name: Immich
summary: Back up the photos and videos from everyone's phones, and browse them like Google Photos.
description:
Immich backs up the photos and videos from your family's phones automatically and lets you browse them on a timeline, on a map, by the people in them, or by searching for things like "beach" or "birthday cake". Albums can be shared with each other. Everything stays on this server.

When installing, choose where Immich keeps the photos: an empty folder such as Media > Photos > Immich is a good place. Immich organises that folder itself (originals, thumbnails, converted videos and its own database backups), so don't put other files in it. If you already have photos on the server, give them to Immich as "Existing photos": it reads them without changing them (add them in Immich under Administration > External Libraries, path /mnt/existing).

Then open Immich, create the administrator account, and install the Immich app on each phone with this server's address. Face and object search run on the processor; the graphics chip, if there is one, is used to convert videos (Administration > Settings > Video Transcoding > Hardware Acceleration).
